items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Ike Quebec was a -- he was a very good friend. And he decided that Willy Nelson would be a good running mate for him. So I said okay. Since I'd hired Ike... I said, 'Well, get Willy.'

ctx.x: And he loved my brother so much, he sent him to West Virginia State to study. Willy had a 'horse', as we called it, you know, a scholarship, because he was a very good basketball player, so they --
